Whether you're a minimalist committed to using only carry-on luggage or rely on luggage sets with suitcases of varying sizes, you'll find stylish options for all the ways you travel. Meanwhile, the clean lines favored by brands like [Carl Friedrik](https://www.bloomingdales.com/buy/carl-friedrik) and [TUMI](https://www.bloomingdales.com/shop/tumi?id=1178463) have made their durable luggage favorites among those who prefer modern vibes and timeless designs. And in [Delsey Paris](https://www.bloomingdales.com/buy/delsey-paris), [Briggs & Riley](https://www.bloomingdales.com/shop/briggs-riley?id=1236859), and [Samsonite](https://www.bloomingdales.com/buy/samsonite), heritage craftsmanship and classic silhouettes yield suitcases that can stand the test of time.
